column2: Set up a minimal Hono API in TypeScript here. One GET /health endpoint returning {status:'ok'}. Use npm, tsx for dev. Don't run install yet.
Now add a GET /users/:id endpoint that reads from an in-memory Map seeded with 3 users. Return 404 if missing.
Add vitest and write tests for both endpoints.
Run npm install and then the tests.
The 404 body should be {error:'not found'} instead of plain text. Fix it.
Should I use a database or keep the Map for now? This is a throwaway demo.
Explain how Hono's routing resolves /users/:id versus /users/me if I added both, and which wins.
Give me a summary of everything you did this session.
